state.goal: SUNNY must use actual Jev both to direct its construction and as an integrated product feature. Every decision must be logged, sources preserved, domain types progressively derived.
state.facts: Pinned live AgentJev0.6B runs locally; tool scripts/jev_tool.py makes actual decisions and stores full request/response/model identity in a hashed SQLite receipt chain. Source database has59894 records. A read-only browser/source viewer is being connected. No canonical musical laws or placements have been derived. Host can execute fixed commands but Jev only chooses among explicitly described options.
state.constraints: No silent fallback, no fake scores, no source mutation, no paid deployment. User explicitly authorizes local tool build. Existing provisional code must be reviewed; synthetic tests are not account conclusions.

questions.question: Which integration should be implemented for usable Jev inside SUNNY now?

options.interactive_gate: Add a local browser decision workbench that sends bounded explicit questions to real Jev, displays full distributions and source IDs, and links immutable receipts; add a fixed-action quarterback CLI with no arbitrary execution.
options.cli_only: Keep actual Jev decisions in the command-line tool and expose read-only receipt history in the browser until later.
options.automatic_canon: Immediately let the model assign final canonical law labels to every imported sentence without source reconciliation.

questions.question: Which concrete guardrail work should be executed next?

options.real_evidence: Use Proofline on an actual source-linked engineering decision package, MightShape's provenance rules, and an appropriately scoped AgentProof new read-only session with its limits stated.
options.fixtures_only: Keep only the existing synthetic Proofline fixture and do not create project-specific evidence.
options.untracked: Implement more features without guardrail evidence or recorded decisions.
